gatewayBasic.description: Gateway UUID as username and one-time-displayed token as password; HTTPS required outside loopback.

detail.description: Machine-readable reason, currently only password_change_required: the session was issued an initial or reset password and must replace it through POST /api/v1/auth/password before any other route answers. Sent with 403.

must_change_password.description: The password was handed over out of band. Until it is replaced through POST /api/v1/auth/password every route except that one, POST /api/v1/auth/logout and GET /api/v1/me answers 403 with detail password_change_required, and the WebSocket refuses the session.

project_ids.description: Projects the caller may see, or null when they see every project.

project_id.description: Optional project to create the gateway in

token.description: Shown once; store securely. Never log.

current.description: strongest RSSI among fresh sightings; null when no gateway hears the tag

AssetRow.description: One registry line: operational identity merged with the tenant's record and its plan summary.

model.description: gateway model id, or device profile id

external_id.description: BLE identity of a device; empty for a gateway

AssetRecord.description: The tenant's editable bookkeeping row for one asset.

MaintenancePlan.description: A recurring maintenance round; a log bound to it moves next_due forward by interval_days.

MaintenanceLog.description: One entry of the append-only maintenance history; it is never updated or deleted.

AssetDetail.description: Everything the asset drawer shows in one round trip.

AutomationNode.description: One block. `type` is one of trigger.event, trigger.metric, cond.time, cond.device, cond.zone, logic.all, logic.any, action.alert, action.notify, action.command.

data.description: Block settings; only the fields of the block's own type are read.

metric.description: temperature, humidity, battery, rssi, or any decoded metric key

sourceHandle.description: Required on an edge leaving a condition block; absent everywhere else.

AutomationDefinition.description: The block graph. At most 40 nodes, 80 edges and 32 KiB of JSON.

Automation.description: One stored 'if this, then that' flow. Evaluated inside the packet transaction on every uplink of the tenant.

revision.description: Bumped on every save; a save carrying a stale revision is rejected with 409.

AutomationProblem.description: One validation failure, addressed to the block or edge the studio should highlight.

blocked.description: Action blocks that were reached but cannot execute (action.command).

AutomationRun.description: One recorded evaluation; the newest 200 per flow are kept.

items.description: [x, y] in metres, origin top-left, y down
[x, y] in metres, origin top-left, y down

gateway_ids.description: gateways covering the zone; roaming wearables whose zone is one of them count as inside

project_ids.description: Projects this member may see. Empty means every project of the workspace.

SignalMatcher.description: How a learned signal is recognised in a raw advertisement. frame: an AD structure / Minew frame version that only appears while the device is triggered. byte: a byte at a fixed offset inside an identified frame, compared under a mask. prefix: an exact raw-payload prefix, used only when the advertisement cannot be split into AD structures at all.

frame.description: Frame key, e.g. ffe1:a1:0x22 (Minew FFE1 0xA1 version 0x22), feaa:0x00 (Eddystone-UID), ibeacon.

offset.description: Index into the frame payload (0 = the first identifying byte of the frame).

mask.description: 0xff is an exact byte comparison; a single-bit mask matches one flag bit.

prefix.description: Lowercase hex prefix of the whole advertisement.

SignalCandidate.description: One explanation of the difference between the two capture phases, ranked and described in Thai so an operator can check it against the device in their hand.

trigger_hits.description: How many trigger-phase advertisements this matcher matches (the evidence for it).

SignalPhase.description: What one capture window collected, so the operator can see whether anything reached the gateway at all before the analysis reports no difference.

observations.description: Archived advertisement rows in the window.

distinct.description: How many different raw payloads those rows held.

SignalSession.description: One teaching run: phase 1 records the device at rest, phase 2 while the operator triggers it.

candidates.description: Populated once both phases are over. Empty means nothing distinguished them; verdict then says so plainly and what to check next. No signature is ever invented.
